title: The Vanishing Bride
description: On her wedding morning at a luxury resort, bride Ishita Verma disappears from a locked suite. Piece together the financial betrayal and escape path.

assets.altText: Locked bridal suite with wedding gown on hanger and untouched jewelry box
Final voice recording retrieved from the bride's phone in the garden

sections.title: Section 1: The Locked Suite
sections.narrative: At 7:02 AM, hotel staff opened the bridal suite to find Ishita missing. The heavy mahogany door was double-deadbolted and the balcony window was latched shut from inside.

questions.prompt: True or False: Forensic inspection confirmed that the bridal suite deadbolt and balcony latch suffered mechanical forced entry.

hints.hintText: Check the locksmith report on the brass deadbolt mechanism.

sections.title: Section 2: The Money Trail
sections.narrative: Auditing the luxury resort accounts reveals that half of the wedding vendor deposits were siphoned off through a dummy shell company two days before the ceremony.

questions.prompt: What discrepancy was uncovered in the wedding vendor budget ledger?

options.optionText: Vendor budget funds were systematically falsified and diverted
The catering contract was cancelled by the venue

hints.hintText: The groom's business partner managed the vendor bank transfers.

sections.title: Section 3: The Burned Note
sections.narrative: In the suite's stone fireplace, detectives recover partially charred cream parchment bearing emergency travel instructions in blue fountain ink.

questions.prompt: What six-letter word is decipherable on the burned note beside the departure time: 'CONFIRMED ______ TO DUBAI'?

hints.hintText: An international air ticket was booked under her maiden name.

sections.title: Section 4: The Last Recording
sections.narrative: Ishita's abandoned phone in the rose garden recorded a 40-second audio memo at 04:15 AM before it was powered down.

questions.prompt: Listen to the recovered voice memo. Who does Ishita state she had to confront about the stolen family trust funds?

metadata.transcript: Rohan lied to everyone. The accounts are completely empty. I have the bank statements in my bag. I cannot go through with this wedding.

hints.hintText: The groom whose family was orchestrating the merger.

sections.title: Section 5: The Grey Hoodie
sections.narrative: Perimeter security captured a lone figure in an oversized grey hoodie slipping past the service dock into a waiting vehicle at 04:45 AM.

questions.prompt: Decipher the coded licence plate suffix on the getaway taxi: 'REVERSE LETTERS OF XYZ: Z-Y-X'

hints.hintText: Simply invert the three alphabetical characters.

clues.title: Falsified Wedding Ledger
clues.clueText: Bank audits show the groom systematically embezzled the bride's dowry trust funds weeks in advance.

clues.title: Charred Flight Itinerary
clues.clueText: Ishita secured an emergency one-way flight ticket under her maiden name upon discovering the fraud.

clues.title: Undamaged Deadbolt Inspection
clues.clueText: The bridal suite door had no signs of forced entry, proving Ishita locked it behind her as she slipped away.

clues.title: Garden Voice Recording
clues.clueText: Ishita's voice memo proves she uncovered Rohan's embezzlement and refused to proceed with the wedding.

clues.title: Service Dock Taxi Still
clues.clueText: Security cameras confirm Ishita boarded an airport taxi at the service dock dressed in disguise.
